basics.label: Basics
basics.description: What you are selling, in your words — and what it costs.

stock.label: Stock
stock.description: Unlimited by default. Track it to stop overselling and show buyers sold-out and “Only N left” badges. The alert number is when that second badge appears. The order limit is separate: it caps how many one buyer can take at once, tracked or not.

shipping.label: Shipping
shipping.description: Written once for your whole store, not per product. Pick a profile only if this one ships differently.

options.label: Options
options.description: Colours, sizes, power outputs — however this product varies. Buyers pick one of each.

photos.label: Photos
photos.description: More angles for the product page. Drop photos onto an option to show them only for it.

specs.label: Specifications
specs.description: Dimensions, materials and specifications for the product page.

documents.label: Documents
documents.description: Certificates, manuals, or spec sheets buyers and regulators can check before buying.

safety.label: Safety and compliance
safety.description: Who made it and how to reach them. EU product-safety law asks for this on physical goods.
safety.about: What Safety and compliance is for

visibility.label: Visibility
visibility.description: Active is live: buyers can see it and buy it right away. Draft is hidden from buyers until you switch it.
